newsitem.title: ITALY: Closure of Banco Napoli deal seen running late.
newsitem.headline: Closure of Banco Napoli deal seen running late.

text.p: Closure of a deal for Banca Nazionale del Lavoro (BNL)and Italian insurer INA to buy a 60 percent stake in troubled Banco Napoli may be later than its expected conclusion on May 20, BNL's chairman said.
BNL and INA are buying the stake in the struggling Naples-based bank from the Italian Treasury which took control of it last year following three years of enormous losses.

BNL chairman Marco Sarcinelli told reporters: "The Treasury will be able to give the go ahead to the conclusion of the operation within 15 days after the advisors' report has been handed over, which has not yet happened."
Advisors Rothschild have been retained by the Treasury as advisors to the 61 billion lire deal.
